# @cfast/forms

> Auto-generated forms from your Drizzle schema. Customize what you need, accept defaults for the rest.

## When to use
Use this package when you have a Drizzle SQLite table and want a working form without manually wiring up inputs, validation, and labels. Supports both create and edit modes, progressive field customization, and pluggable UI libraries.

## Key concepts
- **Schema-driven**: Your Drizzle table is the source of truth. Column types map to input types, nullability maps to required/optional, enums map to selects.
- **Progressive customization**: Start with `<AutoForm table={posts} mode="create" />`. Override individual fields incrementally -- labels, components, visibility, validation -- without rewriting the form.
- **Headless core + UI plugins**: The core (`introspectTable`, `createResolver`, `createAutoForm`) is UI-agnostic. Rendering is delegated to a plugin. Ships with MUI Joy UI (`@cfast/forms/joy`).
- **Validation via `v()`**: Attach validation rules directly to Drizzle column builders. The rules are stored as metadata and read back during introspection.
- **Parent-child forms**: Declare nested child tables via the `nested` prop — each becomes a `useFieldArray` with add / remove / reorder controls, full schema-derived validation, and `min` / `max` constraints. The values type is inferred from `table` + each `nested[].table`, so `onSubmit` is fully typed without manual generics. See the "Parent-child tables" section below. (The old `children: Record<string, ChildTableConfig>` prop is deprecated — see "Migration".)
- **Computed fields**: Declare derived fields via `fields[name].computed` — they auto-recalculate when any dependency (including child row values) changes. Typically paired with `readOnly: true`.

## API Reference

### Core (`@cfast/forms`)

```typescript
// Introspect a Drizzle table into field definitions
function introspectTable(table: SQLiteTable): FieldDefinition[];

// Build a react-hook-form resolver from field definitions
function createResolver(
  fields: FieldDefinition[],
  fieldOverrides?: Partial<Record<string, FieldConfig>>
): Resolver<FieldValues>;

// Attach validation rules to a Drizzle column builder
function v<T extends ColumnBuilderBase>(builder: T, rules: ValidationRules): T;

// Register UI components as a plugin
function createFormPlugin(config: { components: FormPluginComponents }): FormPlugin;

// Create an AutoForm component from a plugin
function createAutoForm(plugin: FormPlugin): React.ComponentType<AutoFormProps>;

type FieldDefinition = {
  name: string;           // column key
  inputType: InputType;   // "text" | "number" | "checkbox" | "select"
  label: string;          // auto-generated from column name
  required: boolean;      // from NOT NULL
  hasDefault: boolean;
  isPrimaryKey: boolean;
  enumValues?: string[];
  validation: ValidationRules;
};

type ValidationRules = {
  minLength?: number;
  maxLength?: number;
  min?: number;
  max?: number;
  pattern?: RegExp;
  message?: string;  // custom error message override
};

type FieldConfig = {
  label?: string;
  placeholder?: string;
  hidden?: boolean;
  default?: unknown;
  component?: React.ComponentType<FieldComponentProps>;
  validate?: (value: unknown) => string | undefined;
  readOnly?: boolean;
  // Compute this field's value from the rest of the form. Runs on every
  // change and pushes the result back via setValue. Typically paired with
  // readOnly: true. Skipped by the validation resolver.
  computed?: (values: Record<string, unknown>) => unknown;
};

type NestedTableConfig = {
  table: SQLiteTable;              // Drizzle table for each row
  foreignKey: string;              // parent-pointing column (TS key, not DB column), excluded from the nested UI
  as?: string;                     // override the key the nested array appears under (default: the table name)
  min?: number;                    // default 0; enforced on submit
  max?: number;                    // default unlimited; enforced on submit
  reorderable?: boolean;           // show move-up / move-down buttons
  fields?: Partial<Record<string, FieldConfig>>;  // per-column overrides
  exclude?: string[];              // extra columns to omit from the row UI
  label?: string;                  // heading override
  addLabel?: string;               // "Add row" button override
};

// Deprecated. Still accepted for backwards compatibility — shimmed to
// `NestedTableConfig` internally, and logs a one-time deprecation warning.
// Scheduled for removal in the next major.
type ChildTableConfig = {
  table: SQLiteTable;
  foreignKey: string;
  minRows?: number;                // renamed to `min` in NestedTableConfig
  maxRows?: number;                // renamed to `max` in NestedTableConfig
  reorderable?: boolean;
  fields?: Partial<Record<string, FieldConfig>>;
  exclude?: string[];
  label?: string;
  addLabel?: string;
};

type FieldComponentProps = {
  name: string;
  label: string;
  placeholder?: string;
  required: boolean;
  readOnly?: boolean;
  error?: string;
  enumValues?: string[];
  register: UseFormRegister<FieldValues>;
};

type FormPluginComponents = {
  textInput: React.ComponentType<FieldComponentProps>;
  numberInput: React.ComponentType<FieldComponentProps>;
  select: React.ComponentType<FieldComponentProps>;
  checkbox: React.ComponentType<FieldComponentProps>;
  form: React.ComponentType<FormWrapperProps>;
  submitButton: React.ComponentType<SubmitButtonProps>;
  // Optional. If omitted, `DefaultChildTable` is used.
  childTable?: React.ComponentType<ChildTableComponentProps>;
};

type InputType = "text" | "number" | "checkbox" | "select";
```

### AutoForm Props

```typescript
type AutoFormProps<
  TTable extends Table = SQLiteTable,
  TNested extends readonly NestedTableConfig[] | undefined = undefined,
> = {
  table: TTable;                                   // Drizzle table to generate from
  mode?: "create" | "edit";                        // default "create"; edit = pre-filled
  data?: Partial<InferAutoFormValues<TTable, TNested>> & Record<string, unknown>;
  onSubmit: (
    values: InferAutoFormValues<TTable, TNested>,  // FULLY TYPED — no casts
  ) => void | Promise<void>;
  fields?: Partial<Record<string, FieldConfig>>;   // per-field overrides
  nested?: TNested;                                // parent-child dynamic field arrays
  children?: Record<string, ChildTableConfig>;     // DEPRECATED — use `nested`
  exclude?: string[];                              // columns to omit
  form?: UseFormReturn<Record<string, unknown>>;   // external RHF instance
};

// InferAutoFormValues<TTable, TNested> resolves to:
//   InferRow<TTable> & { [nestedKey]: Array<InferRow<NestedTable>> }
// where each `nestedKey` is either the config's `as` override or the nested
// table's runtime name. No manual generics needed on `useForm`; no casts
// needed inside `onSubmit`.
```

### Joy UI Plugin (`@cfast/forms/joy`)

```typescript
import { AutoForm } from "@cfast/forms/joy";
// Pre-built AutoForm using MUI Joy UI components. Ready to use.
```

## Usage Examples

### Minimal create form
```typescript
import { AutoForm } from "@cfast/forms/joy";
import { posts } from "./schema";

function CreatePost() {
  return <AutoForm table={posts} mode="create" onSubmit={handleSubmit} />;
}
```

### Edit form with customizations
```typescript
<AutoForm
  table={posts}
  mode="edit"
  data={existingPost}
  fields={{
    title: { label: "Post Title", placeholder: "Enter a title..." },
    content: { component: RichTextEditor },
    authorId: { hidden: true, default: currentUser.id },
  }}
  exclude={["createdAt", "updatedAt"]}
  onSubmit={handleSubmit}
/>
```

### Schema-level validation with `v()`
```typescript
import { v } from "@cfast/forms";
import { sqliteTable, text, integer } from "drizzle-orm/sqlite-core";

export const posts = sqliteTable("posts", {
  title: v(text("title").notNull(), { minLength: 3, maxLength: 200 }),
  views: v(integer("views"), { min: 0 }),
  slug: v(text("slug").notNull(), { pattern: /^[a-z0-9-]+$/ }),
  content: text("content").notNull(),
});
```

### Parent-child tables (dynamic field arrays)
```typescript
import { AutoForm } from "@cfast/forms/joy";
import { recipes, ingredients } from "./schema";

<AutoForm
  table={recipes}
  exclude={["id"]}
  nested={[
    {
      table: ingredients,
      foreignKey: "recipeId",  // TS column key on ingredients pointing at recipes.id
      min: 1,
      max: 50,
      reorderable: true,
      fields: {
        name: { placeholder: "Flour" },
        amount: { placeholder: "g" },
      },
    },
  ]}
  onSubmit={async (values) => {
    // values is FULLY TYPED — no casts.
    //   values.title: string
    //   values.servings: number
    //   values.ingredients: Array<InferRow<typeof ingredients>>
    //
    // The foreign-key column is automatically excluded from the rendered
    // rows — the action layer stamps the parent id after creating the
    // parent row.
  }}
/>;
```

Each nested entry is introspected like the parent: column types drive inputs,
NOT NULL drives `required`, enums become selects, and `v()` rules flow through.
The default nested table renders add / remove / reorder buttons; plugins can
ship their own `childTable` component to match their design system
(`@cfast/forms/joy` includes one).

**The form key** a nested array appears under in submitted values defaults to
the nested table's runtime name (e.g. `sqliteTable("ingredients", …)` →
`values.ingredients`). Override with `as` when the table name doesn't match
what you want on the payload, or when two nested tables would otherwise
collide:

```typescript
nested={[
  {
    table: orderLines,
    foreignKey: "orderId",
    as: "lines",  // → values.lines instead of values.order_lines
  },
]}
```

Two nested entries resolving to the same key throw at render time with a
message prompting you to pass an explicit `as`.

### Computed fields
```typescript
<AutoForm
  table={recipes}
  nested={[
    {
      table: ingredients,
      foreignKey: "recipeId",
      min: 1,
    },
  ]}
  fields={{
    totalCalories: {
      readOnly: true,
      computed: (values) =>
        // `values` is typed as the parent row + nested arrays, so no cast.
        values.ingredients.reduce(
          (sum, ing) => sum + (ing.calories * ing.amount) / 100,
          0,
        ),
    },
  }}
  onSubmit={handleSubmit}
/>;
```

`computed` functions run whenever any watched form value changes (including
child rows), and the result is written back to the field via `setValue`.
Computed fields are skipped by the validation resolver — they are derived
from other inputs rather than user-provided. Pair with `readOnly: true` to
prevent the user from typing into the computed cell.

### Migration: `children` → `nested`

The old `children: Record<string, ChildTableConfig>` prop is deprecated because
it (a) collides with React's reserved `children` attribute and (b) forces
callers into `useForm<Record<string, unknown>>() + as RecipeFormData` casts
since the form value type cannot be inferred from a generic JSX attribute.

```typescript
// Before (deprecated — still works, logs a one-time warning)
<AutoForm
  table={recipes}
  children={{
    ingredients: {
      table: ingredients,
      foreignKey: "recipeId",
      minRows: 1,
      maxRows: 50,
    },
  }}
  onSubmit={(values) => {
    // values is `Record<string, unknown>`
    const rows = values.ingredients as Array<Ingredient>;  // cast required
  }}
/>

// After
<AutoForm
  table={recipes}
  nested={[
    {
      table: ingredients,
      foreignKey: "recipeId",
      min: 1,   // minRows → min
      max: 50,  // maxRows → max
    },
  ]}
  onSubmit={(values) => {
    values.ingredients;  // Array<InferRow<typeof ingredients>> — inferred
  }}
/>
```

Mapping:
- `children[key]` → `nested[n]` with `as: key` if the key differs from the table name
- `minRows` → `min`
- `maxRows` → `max`
- `foreignKey` stays the same (TS column key, not the DB column name)
- Everything else (`reorderable`, `fields`, `exclude`, `label`, `addLabel`) is unchanged

The shim forwards the old shape to the new one internally, so you can migrate
one form at a time. Both props can even coexist in a single `<AutoForm>` —
the shim logs a deprecation warning once per process.

### Custom UI plugin
```typescript
import { createFormPlugin, createAutoForm } from "@cfast/forms";

const myPlugin = createFormPlugin({
  components: {
    textInput: MyTextInput,
    numberInput: MyNumberInput,
    select: MySelect,
    checkbox: MyCheckbox,
    form: MyFormWrapper,
    submitButton: MySubmitButton,
  },
});

export const AutoForm = createAutoForm(myPlugin);
```

## Column-to-input mapping
| Drizzle Column              | InputType    |
|-----------------------------|--------------|
| `text` / `varchar`          | `"text"`     |
| `integer`                   | `"number"`   |
| `integer({ mode: "boolean" })` | `"checkbox"` |
| `text({ enum: [...] })`    | `"select"`   |

## Integration
- **Drizzle ORM**: `introspectTable` reads column metadata via `getTableColumns`. The `v()` helper stores validation on column builder internals.
- **react-hook-form**: `createResolver` produces a RHF-compatible resolver. AutoForm uses `useForm` internally (or accepts an external instance).

## Common Mistakes
- Using `v()` on the built column instead of the builder: `v(text("title").notNull(), rules)` is correct. `v(text("title"), rules).notNull()` is also fine. But you cannot call `v()` after the table is created.
- Forgetting `mode="edit"` when passing `data` -- in create mode, `data` is ignored.
- Passing a `fields.validate` function that returns `undefined` on error instead of an error string. Return a string to indicate failure, `undefined` to pass.
- Excluding a required field without providing a default -- the form will fail validation since the field is NOT NULL but has no input.
- Forgetting to `exclude` the parent primary key when a nested table points at it: the parent primary key is often auto-generated server-side, so add it to `exclude` on the parent form.
- Declaring a `computed` field without `readOnly: true`: the user will be able to type into it but their input will be immediately overwritten the next time a dependency changes. Almost always a bug — set `readOnly: true`.
- Throwing from a `computed` function: thrown errors are swallowed (so transient mid-edit invalid states don't crash), but the field value will not update until the next successful run.
- Using the deprecated `children` prop in new code: it still works via a shim but loses type inference on `onSubmit`. Use `nested` instead.
- Passing the DB column name (snake_case) as `foreignKey` when your Drizzle TS key is camelCase: `foreignKey` takes the TypeScript column key, not the database column name. `recipeId` not `recipe_id` (unless you declared the TS key as `recipe_id`).
